what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Colombia in Spain: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 66345 Colombian asylum seekers in Spain, 21.9% of all asylum seekers from Colombia.
Refugees from Colombia, a separate group, live mostly in Ecuador, Venezuela, Canada and Costa Rica.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Colombia in every year from 2005 to 2025, with the ELN, FARC, FARC-EMC and FARC - Segunda Marquetalia among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2023 to 2025, fall within this period of conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 401 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 92460, at the end of 2024 and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Spain.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Spain only.
